items.x: Goal! England 0, Congo DR 1. Brian Cipenga (Congo DR) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Chancel Mbemba.
Ngal'ayel Mukau (Congo DR) wins a free kick in the defensive half.
